title: A `Core` class, enum, interface or compiler attribute is declared in a generated stub file the server writes once per version, which is what a jump to a `Core` name opens, and which is read-only and never diagnosed
divergesFromPhp: PhpStorm ships a hand-maintained stub tree for PHP's built-ins; here the stubs are generated from the registry the runtime dispatches on, so a stub cannot say what the binary does not do
